# A developer offered to lease your land for solar. Is the offer worth it?

> Free solar lease calculator for landowners: present value of an option-plus-term solar lease against what your land earns now, the break-even rent and escalator, and rent as a share of project revenue. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
